_note:
L5 routing eval set. Two halves, both load-bearing. `should_match` measures recall: can an agent describing its predicament in its own words find the right model? `should_match_nothing` measures false-positive control: a router that always returns something turns the whole module into noise, and cc-thinking-skills validates its own router on exactly these two axes.

The no-match floor in route.py is CALIBRATED against this file, not chosen. tests/routing/test_route.py recomputes the calibration and asserts the constant, so the floor cannot drift into being a voodoo constant.

Queries are deliberately phrased the way an agent would describe the situation mid-task, not in the model's vocabulary - skill-retrieval research finds terminology mismatch to be the dominant failure of naive selection.
